    Recite the Creed

    Say it aloud. The app follows along and marks each word as you get it.

    This one needs the internet

    To follow along, this uses your device's speech recognition — which sends what you say to your browser's speech service and needs a connection. It is the only part of this app that does.

    Your recitation is scored here on your device. Nothing about your score, your notes, or your study history leaves it, and the rest of the app keeps working offline exactly as before.
